title: 嗚呼、美しき我が御世よ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O's first three years are a resounding success and a fitting origin story for the Centurial Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she makes her morning entrance, the curtains open.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! I'm indestructible! My supreme rule begins now!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, again, I am victorious… My castle's treasury is already filled to the brim with G1 trophies.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hnngh… Second again… I'd like to win at least once.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: As per usual, T.M. Opera O takes first place with Meisho Doto in second!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: No one can break their one-two finish. No one! They've established a true dynasty!

text_block_list.name: Skillful Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: It's over… It's all over… No one else will ever take the G1 crown again.

text_block_list.name: Skillful Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: It's the dark ages… We're doomed, I tell you! DOOMED!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's not like we're about to die here, come on…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smiles have disappeared from the many faces within Tracen Academy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Centurial Overlord's looming presence is now a dark cloud. It crushes their dreams, one after another.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, heh heh heh… Hehehehehe…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! How beautiful! Is it not the most splendid sight you've ever beheld?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Complete domination, like I had always dreamed of!
choice_data_list: Don't you think… this is a bit much?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I, um… might agree. Everyone seems a little shaken.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, nonsense. You simply do not see.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Look there! Behold the scene!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The dark clouds suddenly part and a beam of light illuminates the training center.

text_block_list.name: Fiery Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O… As soon as I debut, I swear I'm gonna take you down!

text_block_list.name: Cool Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heh, yeah right. Good luck coming up with a strategy when there are no openings.

text_block_list.name: Cool Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: We'll both get our butts handed to us.

text_block_list.name: Fiery Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Well… How 'bout training with me? If we put our heads together, we can come up with something to end her reign!

text_block_list.name: Cool Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't be caught dead teaming up with you… But I guess I've got no choice. You're on!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Shadows exist when there is light. Hope is born from despair. And…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: So long as the Centurial Overlord remains, others will join forces to topple her reign!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Beneath a kingdom of terror, new buds take hold within the earth.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: An iron fist ensures that they will grow stronger still.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My dream has been realized. Under the Centurial Overlord's absolute rule, brave souls rise to challenge it!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That endless cycle of strife shall drive my eternal kingdom to completion!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! It is domination under the name of inspiration. Haaah hah hah hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all this time, T.M. Opera O's true plan is coming to light.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But something about it feels a little improvised on the spot… I'll refrain from asking.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Perfect as always, Opera O. Then, what happens when the ultimate hero is born?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Excellent question. The chosen hero will one day arrive at my castle gate, and the final battle will commence.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I shall defeat said hero by the slimmest of margins, thus shattering their heart and soul to shards!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! It is back to square one, hero! Off to fringe theatre with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unlike a demon lord, she doesn't consider losing to be a possibility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O narrows her eyes and looks down from the rooftop onto the world below.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ahh! This beauty… My kingdom absolute.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The verdant fields through which I run. the pleasant shade cast by the towering zelkova trees… Nature's beauty is marvelous.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer and all those who serve me standing at my side… The bonds we hold are beautiful.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And those who stand against me? Beautiful are the flowers which bloom in the face of adversity.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Above all, I am overwhelming, absolute, and infinite…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I, the Centurial Overlord, do truly shine! T.M. Opera O—the epitome of beauty!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: HAAAH HA HA HA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's everyone's ruler, aspiration, and greatest fear. T.M. Opera O reigns over all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tale of this momentous time will surely be passed down through generations of Umamusume as the greatest drama ever written.
